headline: A 2021 law renamed Weir Farm National Historic Site in Connecticut as Weir Farm National Historical Park.
what_it_does: The law changes the official name and designation of Weir Farm in Connecticut from a national historic site to a national historical park. The summary describes only this redesignation and does not mention new funding, new rules, or new land boundaries. It was signed into law on January 5, 2021.
when_it_takes_effect: It took effect when it was enacted on January 5, 2021.
